note: YOLO11n COCO-pretrained, exported to ONNX at a fixed imgsz. Started at imgsz 320; raised to 640 after the benchmark: on the 640x360 camera, 320 missed the person and the bottle that 640 detects, and 640 costs about 3 ms per frame on the GPU. To go back to 320 copy the three values from alternatives.imgsz_320. Off by default; enable with --yolo or --yolo-debug (these also switch the RGB-D camera on). Detection output only: never produces velocity commands and is not read by navigation or locomotion.
